rules.interaction: Local rent control; no state rule in this text overrides it.

exempt_if.unavailable: exempt newly constructed dwelling, building vacant since January 1, 1984, decontrolled unit or bona fide condo/co-op owner-occupied unit (section 155-2, art. VII to VIII)

rules.exemptions: Newly constructed dwellings and buildings completely vacant since January 1, 1984 may be exempt (referenced only; criteria not in this text); vacancy decontrol and condo/co-op initial rental decontrol (art. VII, VIII) not captured
rules.coverage_conditions: Dwellings to which Hoboken Code ch. 155 is applicable (coverage section 155-2 is not in this text)
rules.title: Hoboken rent control: annual increase cap
rules.requirement: At lease renewal a landlord of a covered unit may not raise rent by more than 5% or the CPI change, whichever is less, and increases need 30 days written notice and a stated reason. Surcharges for taxes, water/sewer and capital improvements need approval and are separate.
rules.quoted_span: no landlord may request or receive a percentage increase in rent which is greater than 5% or the percentage difference between the consumer price index

notes: Section headings are stripped, so the cap paragraph sits under section 155-4 by inference from the amendment lists; the 2019-01-16 date (Ord. B-104) is the last amendment listed after the cap paragraph and could belong to it only by ecode layout (section 155-3 was amended 2025-10-22, Ord. B-818). Coverage/exemption criteria (section 155-2, decontrol) are NOT in this page. No just-cause, deposit, fee, screening or algorithm rules in this article.
